name.info: Shown in the user menu, in member lists and as the actor of your actions in the audit log. Earlier audit events keep the old name.

password.title: Change password
password.description: All your other sessions are signed out when the password changes. This browser stays signed in.
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.setDescription: You currently sign in with single sign-on only. A password enables password sign-in as well. For your security this needs a recent sign-in.
password.reauthBody: Setting a first password is only allowed shortly after you signed in. Sign in again (you come back here), then set the password within a few minutes.
password.rules: At least the server's minimum length (12 characters unless the operator changed it), not your email address, and at least 4 different characters.
